title: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW will soon preserve grants, comments and tags by default
body:
Starting December 2, 2026, `CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW` will update views in-place, instead of dropping and re-creating the view. Grants, tags, and comments are preserved with two caveats:

* As views execute with view owner's permissions, grants are not preserved if a non-owner alters the view query via `CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW`
* You must first remove [governed tags](/aws/en/admin/governed-tags) on a view column before dropping the column via `CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW`. Otherwise, the statement will fail with a `CANNOT_DROP_TAGGED_COLUMN` error to protect the [ABAC](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/abac) policies that depend on them ([learn more](/aws/en/database-objects/tags#drop)).

Use `CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW <catalog>.<schema>.<view> NOCOPY * …` to drop grants, tags and comments on view explicitly (governed tags are still retained).

See [Upcoming change to CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW metadata preservation](https://kb.databricks.com/dbsql/upcoming-change-to-create-or-replace-view-metadata-preservation).
